# @astrolib

Vendored copy of [`@astrolib/seo`](https://github.com/onwidget/astrolib) (1.0.0-beta.8) by onWidget, MIT licensed.

This package is no longer maintained and only supports Astro 5 and lower, so its sources live here to keep upgrading Astro.

It is still imported as `@astrolib/seo` thanks to an alias (`vite.resolve.alias` in `astro.config.ts` and `paths` in `tsconfig.json`).
